items.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 4 at 12:20PM AKDT until September 4 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to 82 degrees.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Temperatures will be the warmest for inland
locations away from the water.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids.

Close curtains during the daytime to reduce sun insulation into the
home and open windows at night to allow the home to cool off. Utilize
fans or community buildings with air conditioning.

items.description:

peak at 1 foot or less above the normal highest tide line, similar
